text:
Situation: Vecuronium bromide has been on FDA's shortage list since 2020-05-06 and remains listed as of 2026-10-21, a duration of 78 months. Current stock across Corvale East and Corvale General ranges from 7.5 to 26.6 days of supply. Labels on hand name Eugia Pharma Specialities Limited and Sun Pharmaceutical Industries Limited, both registered plants for this product.

Why (FDA record): FDA's shortage list shows vecuronium bromide posted 2020-05-06 and still listed 2026-10-21. Sun Pharmaceutical Industries Limited has OAI inspections ending 2019-12-13 (1112832) and 2025-06-13 (1272871). Eugia Pharma Specialities Limited received an OAI classification letter dated 2026-09-21, 2329 days after the shortage posting.

Our position: Supply is constrained and dependent on manufacturers with recent OAI classifications. Mylan Institutional LLC product is not on FDA's shortage list today and is manufactured at MYLAN LABS LTD. An approved therapeutic interchange exists for Gland Pharma Limited product (NDC 68083013910), approved by Jordan Hale, PharmD on 2026-01-27.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders with Mylan Institutional LLC as preferred purchasing option per rule.
2. Pharmacist to implement therapeutic interchange to Gland Pharma Limited product per existing approval by Jordan Hale, PharmD.
3. Buyer to evaluate HF Acquisition Co LLC, Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc., and Meitheal Pharmaceuticals Inc. as secondary sources; none are on FDA's shortage list today.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes; those are for treating clinicians and the committee.
